d: The next Lionel Messi, a Barcelona superstar and a World Cup winner at just 19. Lamine Yamal has achieved what most footballers can only dream of, yet his confidence, outspoken personality and family background have made him a target of relentless scrutiny. Now, his decision to miss Spain's UEFA Nations League match is getting questioned. Rupha Ramani dives deep on the burden of being football's next big superstar, the double standards surrounding Yamal and why the teenager should be allowed to define himself on his own terms.
